record.title: Solar Water Heating Collectors - Domestic Thermal Systems
record.description:
Specified thermal efficiency, durability, connection, and basic safety requirements for domestic solar water-heating collectors used in small building-scale systems.

Applied to the earlier collector design classes covered by the demo catalogue; retained for historical searches and replacement tracing.

Key requirements: Collector shall achieve the declared thermal output under the defined test condition.; Hydraulic connections shall remain leak-tight under the specified pressure.; Thermal cycling shall not cause unacceptable functional damage.

Testing: Thermal efficiency test under defined irradiance and inlet conditions.; Pressure and leakage test.
record.certification_applicability: Certification was applicable under the earlier demo conformity route when invoked by procurement or product-control conditions; current conformity should use the replacement record.
